description:
Redwood Inference is running a focused FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint to improve serving-runtime performance (kernel execution + scheduling) for the most common hosted models and GPU SKUs. The goal is to produce a defensible, reproducible benchmark matrix that compares quantization-friendly kernels (FP8 and INT8 variants) against current baselines across realistic workloads (prefill/decode mixes, prompt-length distributions, batch sizes, and concurrency), and to translate the results into concrete runtime decisions: kernel auto-selection updates, scheduler parameter tuning, and updated quantization profiles for the hosted model catalog.

Scope includes: (1) updating/validating benchmark harnesses (microbench + end-to-end serving), (2) executing benchmark runs across the primary fleet GPUs (e.g., H100 and A100, plus at least one cost-focused SKU such as L4 where applicable), (3) analyzing performance vs. quality trade-offs in partnership with Applied ML/Evals, (4) codifying kernel-selection heuristics and regression thresholds (perf canary + CI gates), and (5) shipping changes behind flags and rolling them out via perf canary before broader enablement.

Key stakeholders:
- Serving Runtime (Kernel): Hiro Tanaka (EM), Grace Kim, Yuki Sato, Isabella Rossi
- Serving Runtime (Scheduling): Sofia Ivanova (EM), Omar El-Sayed, Lena Fischer, Marcus Reed, Julian Moore
- Performance & Evals / Quantization: Jonas Weber, Arjun Desai, Claire Dubois, Priyanka Bose, Olivia Grant, Rina Kobayashi
- Infra/SRE/Observability: Neha Kapoor, Irene Choi, Vanessa Ortiz, Keiko Yamamoto, Allison Grant, Rafael Mendes
- Product/Optimize + Perf transparency: Aditya Rao, Henry Cho

Timeline (sprint-style, ~2 weeks):
1) Kickoff + methodology sign-off; reserve GPU capacity; finalize model/workload list.
2) Harness updates + calibration runs; validate correctness and measurement stability.
3) Full benchmark execution across GPU/model/workload matrix; daily triage for anomalies.
4) Analysis + decisions: kernel auto-selection heuristics, scheduler knobs, and quantization profile policy.
5) Implementation + perf-canary gates; staged rollout and documentation updates.

Deliverables:
- Benchmark matrix (per model/GPU/workload) with p50/p95 latency, throughput, cost proxies, and variance.
- Updated kernel-selection logic and/or registry entries; scheduler tuning changes where warranted.
- Quantization profile guidance for hosted catalog + any customer-facing benchmark update inputs.
- Perf canary thresholds and dashboards; regression triage playbook updates.
- Runtime release notes and an internal exec readout with results and recommended next steps.

Constraints and risk management: benchmark reproducibility (clocking, thermals, MIG/partitioning, driver/CUDA differences), correctness/quality regressions under quantization, and avoiding customer-impacting latency regressions during rollout (mitigated via flags, canarying, and SRE alerting).

files.description: Sprint overview page: goals, in-scope models/GPUs, owners, run schedule, required infrastructure, definition of done, and links to Linear epics/PRs and the benchmark result sheet.

Benchmark methodology for kernel comparisons: workload definitions (prefill vs decode), representative seq-len distributions, warmup rules, clock/driver pinning guidance, error bars, and how to interpret wins/regressions.
ADR capturing the chosen FP8/INT8 kernel auto-selection heuristics (by GPU arch, hidden size, head dim, seq-len regime), plus fallback rules, guardrails, and rollout plan.
Performance standards update: required metrics, acceptable variance, minimum run counts, and how benchmark claims can be used in internal/external contexts (and what must be footnoted).
Quantization profile policy for hosted models: which models get FP8 vs INT8 defaults, calibration requirements, known accuracy risks, and when to require an eval sign-off before enabling by default.
Definition of the benchmark suite (prompt sets, distributions, generation lengths, tool-calling/structured-output variants), including rationale for why it matches production traffic.
Triage playbook for FP8/INT8 regressions: symptoms, first checks (driver/CUDA, clocks, cache state), dashboards to consult, bisect strategy, and escalation paths to runtime/SRE.
Step-by-step profiling guide (Nsight Systems/Compute + CUPTI) focused on quantized kernels: what traces to capture, common bottlenecks (memory bound, launch overhead), and how to compare runs.
GPU reservation plan for the sprint: which regions/clusters, instance types, time windows, safety buffers, and how to avoid collisions with customer Dedicated pools.
Dashboards/alerts spec for benchmark and rollout monitoring: key metrics (TTFT, TPOT, tokens/s, GPU mem), dimensioning (model/GPU/region), and alert thresholds for canarying.
Operational runbook for enabling new kernels behind flags and rolling out via perf canary: steps, rollback triggers, and comms templates for #eng-runtime/#eng-sre.
Runtime release notes draft: kernel/scheduler changes, flags, known limitations, expected perf impact ranges, and verification checklist.
Working spreadsheet: benchmark matrix with tabs per GPU (H100/A100/others), per model, per workload; includes raw runs, aggregates, variance, and notes about anomalies.
Microbenchmark results doc/sheet hybrid: kernel-level latency breakdowns (matmul/attention), launch configs, and notes on which shapes benefit most from FP8/INT8.
Working notes analyzing scheduler interactions (continuous batching, prefill/decode interleaving, backpressure) and how they shift the apparent kernel wins at end-to-end level.
Checklist for running benchmark jobs reproducibly: environment pinning, container versions, GPU clocking settings, warmups, and where to upload artifacts.
Daily scratchpad capturing progress, blockers, quick decisions, links to Slack threads, and “to investigate” items as benchmark anomalies show up.
Slide deck draft for leadership: headline wins, GPU/model coverage, risks/rollout plan, and recommended next investments (kernel work vs scheduling vs fleet).
Infra cost/capacity sheet: requested H100 hours by region, expected spend, approval status, and alternatives if capacity is constrained.
Metric definition doc: exact counters/histograms used for TTFT/TPOT/tokens-per-sec, GPU utilization, and how to compare between baselines and canary.
Applied ML summary doc: eval results comparing FP8/INT8 vs baseline on key prompt sets; highlights any model-specific quality regressions and recommended mitigations.
Product working doc: draft UX copy and constraints for Optimize recommendations (when to suggest FP8/INT8), including disclaimers and links to internal methodology.
Epic tracking the sprint: scope, milestones, sub-issues, owners, and links to benchmark artifacts.
Task to add FP8/INT8 modes, consistent warmup/measurement, and shape sweeps into the benchmarking harness; includes acceptance criteria and linked PRs.
Engineering task for integrating FP8 attention kernels behind a runtime flag and wiring into kernel registry/dispatch.
Task defining INT8 matmul integration + correctness fallbacks (shape constraints, alignment, per-GPU support), including unit tests requirements.
Task to add scheduler-level tracing/metrics enabling apples-to-apples comparisons across kernel configs in mixed workloads.
Task to implement perf canary gating: thresholds, noise handling, automatic rollback triggers, and runbooks.
Task for observability dashboards and alerts (model/GPU/region slices), including owner handoff to SRE.
Execution task: run the full benchmark matrix on H100/A100 for the top hosted models; includes artifact upload checklist and review sign-off.
Investigation task for high variance runs; documents hypotheses (clock drift, contention, driver mismatch) and resulting harness/fleet mitigations.
Implementation task derived from the ADR: codify the selected heuristics in runtime dispatch, plus guardrails and tests.
Release planning task: flags, staging plan, canary cohorts, rollback criteria, and comms checklist.
PM task to update internal/external benchmark narratives: what can be claimed, how to footnote, and which models/SKUs get updated charts.
PM task to decide product defaults and eligibility rules for recommending FP8/INT8 configs, including required eval sign-offs.
PM/CS enablement task: draft customer-facing messaging and FAQ stubs for customers who ask about FP8/INT8 performance and quality.
PR adding FP8/INT8 toggles, consistent warmup/measurement loops, and standardized artifact export for the runtime perf suite.
PR wiring FP8 attention kernels into the runtime with feature flags, kernel registry entries, and basic correctness tests.
PR implementing INT8 matmul dispatch rules, shape constraints, and fallback to baseline kernels when unsupported.
PR adding scheduler instrumentation (prefill/decode breakdown, queue depth histograms, backpressure counters) used for benchmark interpretation.
PR implementing the ADR-selected heuristics for choosing FP8/INT8 kernels by GPU and shape regime, including unit tests and config docs.
Bugfix PR for a correctness/perf edge case related to KV cache alignment impacting quantized decode performance.
PR adding structured metadata to benchmark artifacts (git SHA, CUDA/driver, clocks, model hash, config) to improve reproducibility.
PR adding gating logic so new kernels can be enabled per model/region cohort with automatic rollback on threshold breach.
PR adding scripts to run the benchmark matrix across GPU pools and aggregate outputs into Drive/warehouse-friendly formats.
PR ensuring benchmark runner pins driver/CUDA container versions and optionally locks GPU clocks to reduce variance.
PR introducing perf canary threshold profiles tuned for FP8/INT8 runs, with noise suppression and per-SKU baselines.
PR adding Grafana dashboards/alerts for benchmark runs and rollout monitoring (TTFT/TPOT/tokens-s, GPU util, error rates).
PR adding a quick quality sanity suite to catch obvious regressions from quantization changes (golden prompts + lightweight scoring).
PR adding model registry metadata for FP8/INT8 variants and placeholders for default selection policy controlled by server-side flags.
PR updating internal runtime docs/config comments: flag names, safe rollout practices, and links to the Confluence runbook.
PR adjusting scheduler defaults (batching window/backpressure) validated by the benchmark suite to better realize kernel wins end-to-end.
PR removing or gating a debug logging path that perturbed benchmark results and introduced variance.
PR adding a CI smoke test covering correctness for FP8/INT8 kernels on a small representative shape set.
PR tagging runtime metrics with model/GPU/kernel-mode dimensions to make canary comparisons and regressions easier to localize.
Hotfix PR disabling FP8 for a problematic shape regime discovered during canary, with fallback and an issue link.
PR adding an option to capture and store Nsight traces for selected benchmark cases to speed kernel bottleneck diagnosis.
PR finalizing runtime release notes for the sprint outcomes, including flags, expected improvements, and known limitations.
PR cleaning up legacy kernel registry entries and simplifying fallback logic after adopting new heuristics.
